key_insight: Factorial analysis identified HVOF settings associated with acceptable hardness, porosity, and oxide content in Cr₃C₂-20(Ni20Cr) coatings on Ti6Al4V.
engineering_relevance: The reported settings offer a starting point for process qualification: 150 mm standoff, 25 g/min powder feed, 475 NLPM hydrogen, and 205 NLPM oxygen.
method: Conducted a reported 24-run full factorial design with spray factors evaluated at two levels.
Measured coating quality responses and used ANOVA to quantify parameter contributions.
Used Pareto charts to assess interactions among spray parameters.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports measured responses across 24 experimental runs but provides no numerical quality results or statistical significance values.
watch_item: Validate the reported settings against application-specific quality thresholds before transferring them to other equipment or coating–substrate systems.
paper_title: Investigation of the Effect of HVOF Spray Parameters on the Quality Properties of Cr3C2-20(Ni20Cr) Coating on Ti6Al4V Substrate
